_note: Official accounts the monitor watches - data, not code. Edit by hand (a PR) or add through POST /v1/monitor/sources. expected_languages: ISO 639-1 codes the account normally speaks ([] = inferred from scans). Each account was verified as described in `method`; weaker ones carry a note.
method: YouTube channel ids resolved from the channel page (externalId) and checked against https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=...; verified_title is the feed <title>. Telegram checked via https://t.me/s/<handle> og:title. Other platform handles are copied from the official site in source_url (or from a verified YouTube channel's header links when noted). Entries with a 'verification' field explain the reverse-link or weaker basis used when the official site blocks automated fetches.

unverified: US House / US Senate: no official chamber-level YouTube or Telegram account found; house.gov and senate.gov list none (senate.gov blocks automated fetches). Committees and members have their own channels — out of scope.

China (State Council / MFA spokesperson): fmprc.gov.cn links no social accounts; X accounts @MFA_China and @SpokespersonCHN exist but are not linked from an official page fetched here. YouTube search turned up no official channel. CGTN/CCTV excluded by request.

Republic of Korea presidential office: no official YouTube found (search shows personal channels of presidents and @thebluehousekr for the former Moon administration); eng.president.go.kr refused the connection.

Brazil: gov.br/planalto links youtube.com/@Presidencia_do_Brasil, which does not resolve to a channel (broken or renamed). CanalGov (UCjaWLFTNqLkq3ZY2BJ4NYRg, 1.68M subs, header links agenciagov.ebc.com.br) looks like the federal government channel but no gov.br page linking it was found.

Indonesia: 'Sekretariat Presiden' YouTube (UC_m_NBgf7ieJBHzb6vvJC5A) is the presidential channel by name and size, but presidenri.go.id was not fetchable and the channel has no header link. Only the Kemensetneg channel linked from setneg.go.id is included.

Belarus president: president.gov.by returned no social links in the one successful fetch and later timed out. Telegram 'pul_1' (Пул Первого, 261K) is a pro-government pool channel, not an official account — excluded.

Ukraine Cabinet and MFA Telegram: tried KabminUA_official, Kabmin_UA_official, KabminUA, MFA_Ukraine, mfa_ukraine, MFAUkraine, ukrainemfa — none exist publicly; kmu.gov.ua and mfa.gov.ua block automated fetches, so the real handles could not be found.

Russia: Ministry of Defence Telegram 'mod_russia' (Минобороны России, 652K) is almost certainly official but no official page linking it was fetched. Russian MFA spokesperson (Zakharova) channel not checked.
Japan: kantei.go.jp and mofa.go.jp render social links client-side or block bots, so X/Instagram handles for the Kantei and MOFA are not recorded.
Saudi Arabia royal court / SPA: spa.gov.sa listed no social links; not included.
Iran MFA: en.mfa.ir not fetchable; not included. Iran's Supreme Leader (leader.ir) page listed no social links.

Georgia government / president / parliament: gov.ge, president.gov.ge and parliament.ge not fetchable. 'Parliament of Georgia' YouTube (@geoparliament, UCidFouPFxyvJee3iFrFukTg, 18.8K) has no header link — not included.

G20: youtube.com/@G20ORG (UCvZR2g6Uquh9Sr4fU1Psvag) links g20.org but last upload is 2018. G7: g7italy.it links youtube.com/@G7Italy2024 and X @G7 — the G7/G20 web presence rotates with each presidency, so neither is a stable source.

UN family without Telegram: none of UN, UN News, UNICEF, WHO, NATO, EU institutions, OSCE or CoE link a Telegram channel from their sites; handles probed directly (UN, UNnews, unicef, WHO, nato, europarliament, eu_eeas, osce, coe) do not exist as public channels or are not the org ('EU_Commission' is a 90-subscriber stub).
Lithuania president YouTube (@PresidentofLithuania) and Kazakhstan MFA YouTube (@foreignministry) are verified but stale (last uploads 2023 / 2024); kept with a STALE note.
